description:
The first research tutorial takes a researcher through a standards-based coded-modulation link simulation with gf2-sim, ending in a reproducible error-rate result.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only. Presets, examples and campaign binaries are surveyed in `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §5.2.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/tutorials/` walks through configuring a DVB-T2 or 5G NR preset pipeline in gf2-sim, running a checkpointed error-rate sweep with a stated frame budget, and interpreting the result.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each command and code block comes from an example or binary in the tree and is verified by running it; the quick path completes in about a minute in release mode.
- [hard] REQ-03: Its prose is freshly authored and contains no elementary primer, history, future promises or performance figures.
- [hard] REQ-04: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links resolve.
title: Write the coded-modulation link simulation tutorial
